title: STAR: Learning Diverse Robot Skill Abstractions through Rotation-Augmented Vector Quantization

layout.note: A one-line pipeline strip on top, separated by a dashed rule from a grid of six toy embedding-space discs below (rows Naive VQ and RaRSQ, columns Before Update, Gradient Flow, After Update).

lesson: Pair a one-line pipeline strip with a rows-by-columns grid of one toy space (rows = methods, columns = before / during / after an update), reusing the codebook colours, so the reader sees where quantization sits and how only the gradient arrows change the outcome.
